text: FAA guidance emphasizes reestablishing the control link or initiating emergency procedures if control is lost, and to discontinue flight if inputs are not synchronized. The DJI Matrice 4T manual states Failsafe RTH is triggered automatically when the signal is lost, may display a pre-generated RTH path, starts Advanced RTH per RTH settings, and uses Original Route RTH if vision conditions are unsuitable, with Preset RTH when the signal is restored.
